name: Casarrubios del Monte (Spain)
description: Quartered blue and white, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Casarrubios del Monte (a castle, a fleur-de-lis and crescents on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Casarrubios del Monte; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Casarrubios del Monte arms — castle, fleur-de-lis and crescents on blue
castle, fleur-de-lis and crown of the arms
